notes: Lumineon Price Feed, Ethereum Sepolia (11155111). Manifest derived from the accepted tree (src/LaunchToken.sol, src/LumineonPriceFeed.sol, script/Deploy.s.sol, docs/deployment.md); solc 0.8.26, optimizer 200 runs, EVM paris, bytecode_hash none. Token: LaunchToken, fixed 10^27 minor units minted to the factory, no constructor arguments, no mint/pause/fee/upgrade; the feed never references it and works without it. Contract: LumineonPriceFeed(address owner_, address attester_), nonpayable, non-upgradeable, no DELEGATECALL/SELFDESTRUCT, holds no funds and has no price override. owner_ = $owner (the requester's policy wallet). Its only powers: approveRequest(bytes32 requestId, bytes32 questionHash), which binds one actual IMD oracle request UUID (16 raw bytes right-padded to bytes32) to that request's questionHash after the owner has checked the request against docs/oracle-request-template.json (approvals are permanent, one accepted answer per ID), and a two-step transferOwnership/acceptOwnership. The owner cannot set, change or clear a price. Passing the factory's msg.sender instead would leave the feed permanently unable to accept any answer, so $owner is required. attester_ = 0x5598Aa9146215Bc13eb26f2c692Ad1461Fd32982, IMD's attestation signer as reported by GET https://api.imd.fun/oracle/requests (field attester) on 2026-10-02 and recovered from a live version-2 signature in test/RealAttestationCompatibility.t.sol; it is immutable, so a signer rotation needs a redeployment. The feed deploys with no observation. Anyone may call submitAttestation(attestation, signature) with the message of GET /oracle/requests/<id>/attestation; it is accepted only if the request ID is owner-approved with a matching questionHash, the signed question chainId is 1, answerType is uint256 with a 32-byte answer equal to figure and greater than zero, panelSize >= 20, quorum >= 14, agreed >= quorum and counts are internally consistent, issuedAt <= block time, expiresAt > block time, age since issuedAt <= 24 h, the request ID is unused, issuedAt is strictly newer than the stored observation, and the EIP-712 v2 signature (domain IdentityMD Oracle v2, chainId 11155111, verifyingContract = this feed) recovers attester_. An unchanged price with a new attestation still refreshes. Readers: latestObservation() returns the stored record plus a freshness flag, priceCents() reverts with NoObservation or StalePrice, isFresh/hasObservation/observationAge/description expose metadata; reads never renew freshness and expiry never erases history. After deployment the operator fills consumer.verifyingContract in the request template (lowercase feed address), pays for the request, approves its ID from the owner wallet, then relays with tools/prepare-update.mjs and an external wallet. The live integration is not claimed until a real attestation is accepted on Sepolia. Pool: lumi paired with native ETH, manifest fee 3000 / tickSpacing 60 for admission; the pool opens at the network's trading fee read from LaunchFees, and the factory supplies PoolInitializationGuard, LP and MerkleDistributor.
